text:
Where is my star kept,

my crystal of love?


The night denies me its dawn torso

and we go strange, detached,

never coinciding.


What for, if I am love to nothing,

am I love in what is unknown of me?


And this tenderness that girds my shoulders,

that awnings the gold of my heart,

what for, if I am searching for water

and know only the echo of the spring?

translation.title: Restlessness
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the inward questioning and the echo of the spring instead of water itself.
